senses.gloss: m. (פוט, v. פִּיּוּט) speaker, esp. (by adaptation to ποιήτης) composer of alphabetical acrostics, poet.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>דהוה … פ׳ ודרשן</he> he was teacher of Bible and of Mishnah, speaker (poet) and preacher; Pesik. U’kaḥ., p. 179ᵃ (Ar. ed. Koh. <cite ref="Q00201"><he>פּוֹיְיטָן</he></cite>, oth. ed. <he>פייטם</he>, <he>פייטס</he>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>פייטויי</he> (corr. acc.).
Ib. to I, 1 הדין פ׳ כד עביד וכ׳ when a poet writes &c., v. אלפ״א; Koh. R. to I, 13 פּוֹיְיטָנָא.—Pl. (h.) פַּיְיטָנִים.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 983">Yalk. Cant. 983</cite> (ref. to <he>חרוזים</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:10">Cant. I, 10</cite>) <he>אלו הפ׳</he> this refers to the poets (in Israel).
